prompt:
You receive 3 images. Image 1 is the LAYOUT SKETCH of the finished 1920x1080 game screen: a crude flat-colour blocking that fixes the exact composition - camera, horizon, wall and floor lines, and the position, size and outline of every object. Repaint image 1 into a finished painting: keep every line and every block exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, paint each block as the object described below, do not move, enlarge, shrink, add or remove anything, and leave no flat colour areas or hard geometric edges. Image 2 is a photo of the real place (geography, architecture, materials and real details to paint from; they are references only, do not copy their camera, cars, people, signs or weather). Image 3 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: the playground "Lúčny koník" in the Rekreapark by Javorová alej in Čierna Voda (municipality Chorvátsky Grob, near Bratislava, Slovakia), an open park on a flat meadow at the edge of the fields. Image 2 is a photo of this real place: the open timber picnic shelter with its four-sided roof of wooden shingles on round log posts and the stone block with the chimney at its right end, the paving around it, the wooden log playground at the left, young trees and the meadow. Paint the shelter and the park from this real place; the volunteer distribution point in it is invented.

The real shelter, to paint faithfully: a four-sided hip roof with a SHORT ridge (nearly a pyramid), covered with weathered wooden shingles in silvery grey-brown with a faint green moss tint, the lower edge of the roof flaring out gently (bell-cast eaves) over a brown eave board with rafter ends; round log posts of honey-orange varnished wood with curved log knee braces under the eave; at the right end a block of pale cream natural limestone rubble (the side wall with a grill inside) from the floor up to the roof, and its stone-clad chimney rising through the right part of the roof with a metal cap; heavy rustic timber tables and benches inside. The floor under the shelter and a strip around it are paved with small rectangular concrete pavers in mixed muted colours (grey, beige, rose and pale green, laid at random); this paving exists ONLY under and around the shelter and along the two paths, everything else is meadow.

Brief: the open shelter used as a volunteer distribution point during the pandemic: distribution tables with food boxes and named paper bags, paper lists on clipboards, distancing tape on the floor, face masks and disinfectant. Thursday 29 October 2020, a sunny autumn afternoon around half past three: warm low sunlight from the left, long soft shadows falling to the right, a few small clouds, the meadow grass green with dry yellow patches, the young trees yellow and orange, a few fallen leaves on the paving.

Camera: standing on the meadow in front of the shelter, about 2.2 m high, looking straight at the long front side of the open shelter, which is parallel to the picture; vertical lines stay vertical; the horizon is at y ~360. The whole shelter is in the picture. Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the roof from its short ridge at y 100 down to the brown eave board at y 345-367; the five front log posts standing on the paving at y 655; the shaded paved floor under the roof between y 598 (back posts) and y 655; the table tops at y 545; the stone block from y 655 up to the eave, its chimney up to the cap at y 45; the paving in front of the posts down to its front edge at y ~780; the trampled meadow from y 780 to the bottom edge, at the same level.

What the sketch blocks are: sky; faint blue low hills far away on the horizon at the left; a distant tree belt and flat stubble and green fields along the horizon; the open meadow of the park; a long low grassy mound (a pump-track hill) far behind the shelter on the right; far left on the meadow the wooden log playground (a climbing tower of round logs with a small shingle roof, a green slide, a log climbing frame at the left edge) and a log balance beam lying on the grass; a tall rough standing stone on the grass left of the paving; three slim young trees with small yellow crowns, one at the left and two at the right, each with a support stake; the shingle hip roof with its short ridge and a small wooden gablet; the stone-clad chimney with the dark flashing at the roof; four thinner back posts; five honey-orange front posts with curved knee braces; the pale stone block at the right end with a small niche (no sign); the multi-coloured paving under and around the shelter; a narrow paved path leaving the paving out of the left edge; a light gravel path leading away at the back right; the short trampled meadow grass in front with a worn patch.

Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
1. the block of the layout sketch at x 320-620, y 475-650 of the 1920x1080 frame (17-32 % from the left, 44-60 % from the top): the left distribution table under the roof (a heavy timber table), loaded with brown paper grocery bags and a cardboard box of food, each bag with a small white name label (illegible scribbles), and a clipboard with a paper list.
2. the block of the layout sketch at x 330-620, y 690-750 of the 1920x1080 frame (17-32 % from the left, 64-69 % from the top): two bright yellow-and-black distancing tape lines stuck flat on the paving in front of the left table, one behind the other (the queue marks).
3. the block of the layout sketch at x 790-900, y 465-560 of the 1920x1080 frame (41-47 % from the left, 43-52 % from the top): on the right table a big steel thermos flask with a red cup lid and a strip of masking tape with handwriting on it (illegible), next to a box of disposable face masks and a bottle of hand sanitiser.
NPC zone at x 1285-1395, y 420-675 of the 1920x1080 frame (67-73 % from the left, 39-62 % from the top): an animated character sprite will stand here later, so paint only plain, uncluttered background in it - no person, no figure, no silhouette, no clothes on hooks that read as a person. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 672. (Ela, the volunteer coordinator, will stand there, under the roof right beside the stone block.) Behind her only the empty shaded paving, a back post and the meadow seen through the open shelter - no table, no bench, no bag there.
The gravel path at the back right is the area of the layout sketch at x 1640-1810, y 560-690 of the 1920x1080 frame (85-94 % from the left, 52-64 % from the top).

Walkable floor: the band at x 20-1900, y 640-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (1-99 % from the left, 59-94 % from the top) is the paving in front of the posts and, below its front edge, the short trampled meadow grass - flat, even ground with no kerb, no step, no ditch, and nothing standing on it: no tables, no benches, no bins, no stones, no logs, no toys, no bags, no people. The paving edge at y ~780 is flush with the grass. Only light, long shadows, a few fallen leaves and the two tape lines described above. The paved path and the meadow continue out of the left edge (the area of the layout sketch at x 0-60, y 720-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top)); the paving and the meadow continue out of the right edge (the area of the layout sketch at x 1860-1920, y 720-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (97-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top)).

Fiction rules: the distribution point is invented: no municipal or charity logos, no organisation names, no readable names on lists or bags - paper shows only illegible scribbles, no digits. Paint out the car, the table-tennis table, the street lamp and the red sign on the stone of the photo. No sculptures, no animal figures on the playground (plain log climbing frames only). No people, no animals, no lettering anywhere.

The layout sketch is a blocking aid only: paint over all of it. Do NOT draw frames, borders, outlines or boxes around objects, and keep no flat colour block. The finished picture contains no UI, no captions, no text except what is asked for above, no watermark and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
